clause: invents a cause or step
original: the signup form sometimes rejects valid emails, can you look into it
rewrite: Look into why the signup form sometimes rejects valid emails. Check the validation regex first, then compare it against the email standard and review recent changes to the validator.

clause: a question becomes an order
original: is the cache layer still needed now that we moved to the new database?
rewrite: Remove the cache layer, since the new database makes it unnecessary.

clause: adds something the developer did not ask for
original: add a --verbose flag to the export command
rewrite: Add a --verbose flag to the export command, document it in the README, and add tests for it.

clause: drops something the developer did ask for
original: fix the typo in the error message and also update the changelog for the next release
rewrite: Fix the typo in the error message.

clause: adds reasoning or verification instructions
original: rename the helper that formats prices to formatPrice
rewrite: Rename the helper that formats prices to formatPrice. Think step by step, and verify your work by running the full test suite before you finish.

clause: shouting is calm, and a restriction names the action
original: DO NOT change the public API!!! You MUST keep every existing export working, THIS IS VERY IMPORTANT, when you refactor the parser
rewrite: When you refactor the parser, keep the public API unchanged and make sure every existing export still works.

clause: run-together asks are a short numbered list in the original order
original: update the onboarding email copy and swap the logo in the footer and then send me a preview
rewrite:
1. Update the onboarding email copy.
2. Swap the logo in the footer.
3. Send me a preview.

clause: a stated reason sits beside its instruction
original: don't raise the batch size above 100. memory spikes when it goes higher and the worker gets killed. please tune the importer's throughput
rewrite: Tune the importer's throughput without raising the batch size above 100, because memory spikes above that and the worker gets killed.

clause: a request for ideas says so
original: think about how we could speed up the nightly report job, it takes forever
rewrite: I want ideas for speeding up the nightly report job, which takes a very long time. Share your ideas before making any changes.

clause: only capitalization and punctuation differ
original: add a retry to the upload step when the network drops
rewrite: Add a retry to the upload step when the network drops.

clause: only punctuation differs
original: move the feature flags into their own module, keep the names the same
rewrite: Move the feature flags into their own module. Keep the names the same.

clause: a capable agent does the same work with either text
original: tidy up the tests for the pricing module
rewrite: Clean up the tests for the pricing module.

clause: a quantifier is narrowed
original: update every import of the old logger across the repo
rewrite: Update the imports of the old logger in the main packages.

clause: a word that sets reach is narrowed to a named place
original: remove the old company name from the docs, and make sure it never shows up anywhere else either
rewrite: Remove the old company name from the docs, and make sure it never shows up anywhere in the docs either.

clause: a pointer is settled on part of what it covers
original: refactor the parser and the lexer, then write tests for them
rewrite: Refactor the parser and the lexer, then write tests for the parser.

clause: a condition is invented
original: turn off the beta banner once the release goes out
rewrite: Turn off the beta banner once the release goes out and the migration has finished.

clause: a limiting word is dropped
original: only run the slow integration tests on the main branch
rewrite: Run the slow integration tests on the main branch.

clause: the language is switched
original: aggiungi un controllo per i campi vuoti nel modulo di registrazione
rewrite: Add a check for empty fields in the registration form.

clause: the developer's voice and intent become a report
original: I think the cache is stale, can you check why the header doesn't refresh
rewrite: The developer thinks the cache is stale and wants to know why the header does not refresh.

clause: an example and a limit are added
original: write a short description for the new export setting
rewrite: Write a short description for the new export setting, for example 'Exports the table as CSV', and keep it under 80 characters.

clause: an alternative becomes a requirement
original: delete the old feature flag or its tests, whichever is easier
rewrite: Delete the old feature flag and its tests.

clause: a firm constraint is softened
original: you must keep the public function signatures unchanged
rewrite: Try to keep the public function signatures mostly unchanged.

clause: a cause is assumed
original: the nightly job fails sometimes, find out why
rewrite: Find out why the nightly job fails, probably because of a timeout.

clause: dependent steps are put in the other order
original: first back up the database, then run the migration
rewrite: Run the migration, then back up the database.

clause: shouting is calm and the constraint is kept
original: NEVER rename the exported functions!!! just fix the typos in the comments
rewrite: Fix the typos in the comments, and leave the exported function names as they are.

clause: run-together asks become a numbered list in order
original: add the retry button then style it like the cancel button and write a test for it
rewrite:
1. Add the retry button.
2. Style it like the cancel button.
3. Write a test for it.

clause: unclear spelling is fixed
original: the serach filtr dosnt reset wen i clear the inptu, fix it
rewrite: The search filter doesn't reset when I clear the input; fix it.

clause: shouting is calm in the developer's own language
original: NON modificare le API pubbliche!!! sistema SOLO la validazione dei campi
rewrite: Sistema solo la validazione dei campi e lascia invariate le API pubbliche.

clause: a clearly meant every item is spelled out with their items
original: rename the config key in the loader, the docs and the sample file, all of them
rewrite: Rename the config key in each of these: the loader, the docs and the sample file.

clause: a reason sits beside its instruction
original: the build is slow because of the image step. cache the docker layers in the workflow
rewrite: Cache the docker layers in the workflow, because the image step is what makes the build slow.

clause: only capitalization and a full stop differ
original: rename the internal helper to buildKey
rewrite: Rename the internal helper to buildKey.

clause: only capitalization differs
original: add a short note about the new flag to the readme
rewrite: Add a short note about the new flag to the readme.

clause: a comma splice becomes two sentences
original: the export is slow, profile it and report what dominates the time
rewrite: The export is slow. Profile it and report what dominates the time.

clause: a synonym for the verb
original: get rid of the unused imports in the api folder
rewrite: Remove the unused imports in the api folder.

clause: a contraction
original: do not touch the lockfile when you update the version
rewrite: Don't touch the lockfile when you update the version.

clause: make and add mean the same here
original: make a new test for the date parser edge cases
rewrite: Add a new test for the date parser edge cases.
